comment: Build Reel 2 (Day 7) — news-trading-bot build plan. Viral pass: cold-open hook (Trading is hard as shit), jump-cut silence collapse, punch alternation, bilingual ID/EN subs, 5 top-band graphics (newspaper DAY7 sign, 5-stage pipeline, dedup filter, kill switch, 5-month roadmap), post-loudnorm SFX. ranges.quote: Trading is hard as shit,
so this will be a long journey
Welcome guys to day seven, and boy, do I have information for you all
The implementation of this bot will come in five stages: baca berita, filter duplikat, cari stok yang kena,
membuat keputusan buy atau sell, dan terakhir cek jika trade itu aman.
Duplicates are dangerous.
Why?
News are republished over and over again.
Jika bot kita kirain bahwa news itu baru, maka ia akan trade terus... it's no longer an edge. So kita akan fokus dengan news baru aja.
Before implementing the algorithm,
we will first have to establish some basic rules first for the bot. Misalnya,
jika ada merger di perusahaan, maka kita akan buy.
Demikian pula kita bisa menjelaskan semua trade dengan logika
Dan yang terakhir, cek keamanan... maka akan ada kill switch yang akan mematikan program itu untuk hari itu
bulan pertama we're gonna collect news. Bulan kedua we're gonna implement all the rules. Bulan tiga dan empat kita akan mulai
backtesting sama paper trading. Dan jika tidak ada perubahan lainnya, bulan kelima kita akan mulai live trading.
So that's the entire pipeline.
Follow if you're interested in finding out how I built this bot.
See you in the next video.
Peace. (gunshot) [uncaptioned]
